rules.summary: Virginia's minimum wage is $12.77 an hour from January 1, 2026 until January 1, 2027.

citation.title: Va. Code § 40.1-28.10 — Minimum wages
citation.excerpt: From January 1, 2026, until January 1, 2027, every employer shall pay to each of its employees wages at a rate not less than the greater of (i) $12.77 per hour

rules.summary: Virginia's minimum wage rises to $13.75 an hour on January 1, 2027.

citation.title: Va. Code § 40.1-28.10 — Minimum wages
citation.excerpt: From January 1, 2027, until January 1, 2028, every employer shall pay to each of its employees wages at a rate not less than the greater of (i) $13.75 per hour
